text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P1 fired for service="inference-queue-eu" alert=PD-20260314-889 -> metric: embeddings_queue_5xx_rate > 10% and p99 latency > 2s. Pager: @maria (primary oncall). link: https://console.redwood/pd/incidents/PD-20260314-889 :rotating_light:

pagerbot: PagerDuty incident created and page fired to rotation. Escalation policy: 3m -> 2m -> 5m repeats.

maria (eng-oncall): ack. I'm on it, joining bridge. Starting initial triage. :white_check_mark:

sam (sre): joining - pinged in bridge. Any customer-impact summary?

carla (support): FYI support is seeing a spike in tickets mentioning embeddings failing with 502/504, a few high-traffic customers reporting degraded search relevance. No major SLA violations flagged yet but customer ops needs status blurb.

maria (eng-oncall): quick summary: spike started ~02:09 UTC. Embeddings 5xx rate ~12% across eu-region pool; request queue length increased and a subset of pods show restarts. Impact: hosted API customers in eu may see failed embeddings and slowed downstream features.

dave (infra): checking autoscaler and pod events. I see `oomkilled`/`liveness` restarts on two embeddings workers since 02:08. Also seeing k8s node pressure on eu-cluster-node-13.

maria (eng-oncall): running quick checks: `kubectl get pods -l app=embeddings -o wide`
```
NAME                                READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE   IP           NODE
embeddings-5d9b6c8b7f-2lqrm        1/1     Running   0          3d    10.2.4.21    eu-cluster-node-13
embeddings-5d9b6c8b7f-7shtk        0/1     CrashLoop 4          5h    10.2.4.22    eu-cluster-node-13
embeddings-5d9b6c8b7f-9mzqv        1/1     Running   1          2d    10.2.5.9     eu-cluster-node-09
```

sam (sre): grabbing logs from the CrashLoop pod - looks like Redis connection timeouts followed by OOM when retry storms occur. snippet: 
```
E 02:08:13 redis: read timeout after 5s
E 02:08:15 kv_cache: connection refused
E 02:08:17 embeddings: out-of-memory (heap exceeded)
```

kai (platform): we pushed a redis config change last night that reduced client-side pool size for failover testing. Could be related; rolling back might help.

maria (eng-oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) scale embeddings deployment to reduce queueing 2) mark node-13 cordon/drain if node pressure persists 3) fallback to cached embeddings where applicable 4) notify support. I'll run scale now.

dave (infra): I'm on node checks. If node is memory-starved we can migrate pods off it.

maria (eng-oncall): `kubectl scale deployment embeddings --replicas=8 -n prod` (executed).

pagerbot: autoscaler override: manual scale applied by maria. Monitoring token-level latency and 5xx graphs.

sam (sre): scaling observed; pods coming up. Also rolling back the redis pool change to previous commit (kai confirmed).

kai (platform): rolled back redis client pool change in configmap `redis-client-config:v2 -> v1`. Pushing restart to redis sidecars to pick up config.

maria (eng-oncall): monitoring metrics: 5xx rate dropped from ~12% to ~3% after scale + redis rollback. p95 latency improving. Still watching.

carla (support): preparing customer status update (draft):
```
We are investigating intermittent errors impacting embeddings in EU region. Engineering has applied a mitigation (scaled service and config rollback). Errors have dropped significantly and we're monitoring. We'll update in 30 minutes or sooner.
```

maria (eng-oncall): good draft, send it. Also attaching runbook we used: https://runbook.redwood/infra/embeddings-5xx-troubleshoot

sam (sre): digging deeper on root cause - preliminary: reduced redis client pool + transient node memory pressure caused retries that amplified memory use in embedding workers. We'll open a follow-up postmortem if this is persistent.

dave (infra): node-13 CPU/mem graphs show spike 02:07-02:10, then recovered after eviction/migration. No hardware failures. I'll leave cordon off for now.

maria (eng-oncall): status update to PD: acknowledged -> investigating -> mitigation applied. Leaving observation period for 20m. Current impact: localized 2-3% 5xx residuals, major drop from peak.

incident-bot: PD incident PD-20260314-889 status updated -> mitigation applied by maria.

maria (eng-oncall): I'm handing off monitoring to sam at 03:00 UTC (15m from now). If errors re-spike, escalate to infra and prepare to fail traffic to fallback model variant. Handing off notes: scaled to 8, redis rollback, watching queue length and pod restarts.

sam (sre): taking over. I'll keep bridge open and will post an update every 10m. Thanks maria.

carla (support): update sent to impacted customers. Template includes mitigation steps and ETA for follow-up.

maria (eng-oncall): logging follow-up ticket and linking to incident in PD. Good job team. :tada:

sam (sre): agreed. I'll file an incident follow-up with logs + timeline. Next steps: tune redis pools, add autoscaling safety cap, consider pod memory limits review.

incident-bot: Incident PD-20260314-889 marked as acknowledged, owner=sam (sre).
